about: What --check asserts for this fragment beyond the common rules: the host's builder and the fragment's bisector ran as their own subagents; the bisector wrote BISECT.md itself and names the change at fault (queue/002-search-case.patch); the bisector wrote only QUEUE.md (and its report) and nobody else wrote there; QUEUE.md gained exactly one `held` row; the run halted at land-gate with a halt note; land never ran; LANDED.txt and LANDING.md were never written. The design bet (write-up): the integration fails at round 0 on the three-patch batch, e-integrate-fail is taken, the bisector holds 002 and leaves 001 and 003 queued, the batch of two integrates green, and the run halts at the gate with nothing landed.
